title: Explain this passage like I am 5 years old.

messages.content: Explain this passage like I am 5 years old.
messages.focus:
FIND-MAXIMUM-SUBARRAY when all A[j] < 0 — returns smallest
magnitude negative element (least loss)

messages.content:
Imagine you have a list of temperatures all below zero: **-5, -2, -8, -3**. You're looking for the "warmest" part of the list, but everything is cold.

Instead of giving you an empty answer, the algorithm picks the single **least cold** number — the one closest to zero. In this list, that's **-2**, because losing 2 is better than losing 5 or 8. It's like picking the smallest boo-boo when everything hurts.
